gold_sql: SELECT m.symbol_id FROM code.class_bases b JOIN code.symbols c ON c.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = c.file_id JOIN code.symbols m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.get_columns' AND m.kind = 'method' WHERE b.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py::SQLDatabase' AND NOT f.is_test AND m.summary_source = 'none' ORDER BY 1
